tools.name: music_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running Google Flow Music job. A queued job spends no credits. For a running job, the server keeps rendering the clips that a tool call already started, and spends their credits; the cancel stops the wait, the download, and the session.

id.description: Eight-character job ID from the queue.

tools.name: music_chat
tools.description: Queue a message to the Google Flow Music Producer agent. The Producer can write lyrics, generate and edit songs, split stems, build Spaces, and plan music videos by itself, thus a message can spend credits. Use a session ID to continue a conversation.

download.description: Download the audio of new clips that the reply creates (default true).

session_id.description: Existing session ID. Omit to create a new session.

timeout_secs.description: Maximum wait for the reply in seconds (default 900, range 30 to 3600).

tools.name: music_download
tools.description: Download the audio (m4a, wav, or mp3), video, or cover art of a song, or a music video, into the local downloads directory.

id.description: Clip ID for "audio" and "image", or a clip ID or music video ID for "video".

kind.description: What to download: "audio" (default), "video", or "image" (the cover art).

tools.name: music_downloads
tools.description: List, inspect, read binary chunks, prune, delete, or clear locally downloaded files.

asset_id.description: Google Flow Music clip or video ID for "get", "read_chunk", or "delete".

existing_only.description: Return only rows whose file currently exists on disk for "list" (default false).

id.description: Download record row ID for "get", "read_chunk", or "delete".

length.description: Maximum chunk size in bytes for "read_chunk" (1..=4_194_304, default 1_048_576).

limit.description: Maximum number of download records to return for "list" (1..=500, default 50).

offset.description: Byte offset in the downloaded file for "read_chunk" (default 0).

older_than_days.description: Delete only files downloaded more than this many days ago when action is "clear".

query.description: Case-insensitive substring that matches asset ID, name, prompt, file name, or path for "list".

session_id.description: Filter by Google Flow Music session ID for "list".

tools.name: music_edit
tools.description: Queue an edit of a song (spends credits): "extend" adds new audio, "replace" rewrites time regions, and "cover" restyles the song but keeps its melody. The result is a new clip.

extend_from_s.description: Start point in seconds for "extend". Default: the end of the clip.

instruction.description: Instruction for the edit, for example "add a guitar solo". Default: a generic instruction for the action.

session_id.description: Session ID for the edit. Default: the session of the source clip.

strength.description: Similarity to the source for "cover", from 0 to 1 (default 0.5).

title.description: Title of the new clip. Default: the source title followed by the action in parentheses.

Region.description: One time region of a clip in seconds.

tools.name: music_generate
tools.description: Queue a song generation job with Lyria (spends credits). Give a sound prompt, and optional lyrics, instrumental, BPM, length, title, seed, and prompt image. Lyrics, BPM, and length are hints. The job downloads the audio when it finishes. Use music_wait to get the result.

bpm.description: Tempo hint in beats per minute. The value goes into the sound prompt.

image_id.description: Image ID from `music_upload` to use as the prompt image.

instrumental.description: Make an instrumental song without vocals (default false).

length_s.description: Length hint in seconds. The model can make a different length.

lyrics.description: Lyrics text. The model uses the lyrics as guidance and can change them. Omit for model-written lyrics.

lyrics_id.description: Lyrics ID from `music_lyrics`. When set, the tool ignores `lyrics` and `length_s`.

prompt.description: Sound description: genre, instruments, mood, and vocal style.

session_id.description: Existing session ID. Omit to create a new session.

tools.name: music_login
tools.description: Sign in to Google Flow Music through a visible Google Chrome window (action "login"), report the session ("status"), or delete the saved session ("logout").

force.description: Delete the saved Chrome profile before interactive sign-in starts (default false).

timeout_secs.description: Maximum wait time in seconds for sign-in completion (default 180, range 15 to 3600).

wait.description: Wait during "login" until sign-in finishes in Chrome (default true).

tools.name: music_lyrics
tools.description: Queue a lyrics job: write new lyrics from a prompt, or edit existing lyrics. The result gives the lyrics text, a title, and a matching sound prompt.

action.description: Action: "write" (default) makes new lyrics from `prompt`; "edit" changes `lyrics` or `lyrics_id` with `prompt`.

lyrics.description: Existing lyrics text to edit for "edit".

lyrics_id.description: Existing lyrics ID to edit for "edit".

session_id.description: Existing session ID. Omit to create a new session.

tools.name: music_playlists
tools.description: List, get, create, update, or delete playlists, and add, remove, or reorder songs in a playlist.

clip_ids.description: Clip IDs for "add" and "remove", or the full new order for "reorder".

id.description: Playlist ID for every action except "list", "favorites", and "create".

limit.description: Maximum number of playlists for "list" (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Number of playlists to skip for "list" (default 0).

tools.name: music_retry
tools.description: Run a failed or cancelled Google Flow Music job again. This spends credits again.

id.description: Eight-character job ID from the queue.

tools.name: music_sessions
tools.description: List, read the transcript of, create, rename, stop, or delete Google Flow Music sessions (Producer conversations).

delete_songs.description: Also delete the songs of the session for "delete" (default false).

delete_spaces.description: Also delete the Spaces of the session for "delete" (default false).

delete_videos.description: Also delete the music videos of the session for "delete" (default false).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions for "list" (default 30, max 100).

offset.description: Number of sessions to skip for "list" (default 0).

tools.name: music_songs
tools.description: List, get, rename, change privacy of, or delete songs (clips) in the Google Flow Music library.

ids.description: Clip IDs for "get" and "delete", or one clip ID for "rename" and "privacy".

limit.description: Maximum number of songs for "list" and "favorites" (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Number of songs to skip for "list" and "favorites" (default 0).

tools.name: music_spaces
tools.description: List, get, change the privacy of, or delete Spaces (interactive instruments and tools). To create a Space, describe it to the Producer with music_chat.

action.description: Action: "list" (default), "get", "privacy", or "delete". Create a Space with music_chat.

id.description: Space version ID (the "id" field of "list") for "get", "privacy", and "delete".

include_files.description: Include the source files of each Space (default false).

limit.description: Maximum number of Spaces for "list" (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Number of Spaces to skip for "list" (default 0).

tools.name: music_status
tools.description: Report Google Flow Music session state, job queue, download index, and browser state. Set probe=true to start Chrome and read the account, plan, and credits.

probe.description: Start Chrome if needed and read the account, plan, and credits (default false).

tools.name: music_stems
tools.description: Queue a stem separation of a song into vocals, drums, bass, and other. The job downloads the four stems.

download.description: Download the four stems: vocals, drums, bass, and other (default true).

session_id.description: Session ID for the job. Default: the session of the source clip.

tools.name: music_upload
tools.description: Upload a local audio file (becomes a clip that music_edit and music_stems can use) or an image file (gives an image ID for music_generate).

kind.description: File kind: "audio" or "image". Default: from the file type.

path.description: Absolute path of a local audio file (under 4 minutes and 40 MiB) or image file (under 5 MiB).

tools.name: music_video
tools.description: List, get, check status of, or delete music videos. Action "create" queues a new video for a song. Kind "social" makes a short vertical 720p clip, waits for the render, and downloads the MP4; the server can make it without credits. Kind "music" makes a custom music video from the song section, the visual direction, and an optional style image; it spends about 12.5 credits per second of video (30 seconds by default), waits for the render (about 5 minutes), and downloads the MP4.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of a "music" video: "9:16" (default) or "16:9".

download.description: Wait for the video to render and download it (default true).

instructions.description: Visual direction for a "music" video, for example the scene and the style.

kind.description: Video type for "create": "music" (default, a custom music video that spends credits) or "social" (a short vertical clip).

length_s.description: Video length in seconds (default 15 for "social", 30 for "music"). A "music" video costs about 12.5 credits per second.

offset.description: Number of videos to skip for "list" (default 0).

session_id.description: Existing session ID for "create". Omit to create a new session.

show_lyrics.description: Show the lyrics on screen in a "music" video (default false).

start_s.description: Start point in the song in seconds for a "music" video (default 0).

style_image_url.description: Style reference image URL for a "music" video, for example the image_url from music_upload.

tools.name: music_wait
tools.description: Wait for queued or running Google Flow Music jobs to finish.

id.description: Single job ID to wait for when `ids` is omitted.

ids.description: Job IDs to wait for (waits for all jobs when omitted).

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in seconds (default 600). One call returns after at most 45 seconds with `pending: true`.
